title: @btopro I wouldn't send faculty a W3C spec. I sent you one. For faculty I would do something like: https://alistapart.com/article/webmentions-enabling
summary: @btopro I wouldn't send faculty a W3C spec. I sent you one. For faculty I would do something like: https://alistapart.com/article/webmentions-enabling-better-communication-on-the-internet But I also want to push back on narrative it is about making the tools frictionless. We also need faculty to step up and learn how to handle the rough edges.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@btopro I wouldn't send faculty a W3C spec. I sent you one. For faculty I would do something like: https://alistapart.com/article/webmentions-enabling-better-communication-on-the-internet

But I also want to push back on narrative it is about making the tools frictionless.

We also need faculty to step up and learn how to handle the rough edges.
